findings.claim: Three sectors carry the room: 27 of 36 nominated tickers, 35 of 47 nominations, and 8 of the 10 names with 2+ seats sit in Technology, Energy and Consumer Discretionary. Read the tally as three sector views first, name picks second.
findings.evidence: gics_sector_name Technology 10 tickers 13 nominations; Energy 9 tickers 11 nominations; Consumer Discretionary 8 tickers 11 nominations; nomination_count 2 on ESTC, FIVN, SAIL, CART, LTH, BBY, EOG, EQNR
findings.what_is_owed: Committee states how many slots it will give each of the three sector views before ranking names inside them.

findings.claim: Energy reads as one factor, not seven setups: seven names show near-identical structure, 8 of 9 share a clean MA stack, and one seat supplied 6 of the 9 tickers. EOG and EQNR reach count 2 partly because elder-lens repeats the sector.
findings.evidence: structure EOG 84.2, CNQ 83.2, OXY 81.1, EQNR 80.0, LNG 80.0, CVX 76.8, DVN 76.8; ma_50 above ma_100 above ma_200 on 8 of 9 Energy rows; elder-lens seats EOG, EQNR, CVX, OXY, DVN, LNG; EQNR seats elder-lens, oneil
findings.what_is_owed: Before anything is sized, the committee says whether it wants one energy exposure or several, and which single name best expresses it.

findings.claim: Technology is 20 of 51 rows. Ten are nominated; ten more (ACN, BRZE, DXC, TTAN, BOX, NTSK, VERX, KVYO, ASAN, ZS) arrive only through doors, so the funnel can re-fill the theme after the seats have stopped.
findings.evidence: gics_sector_name Technology 20 rows; tally doors STRONG_SEAT on BRZE, DXC, TTAN, BOX, NTSK, VERX, KVYO, ASAN, ZS; nomination_count 0 on all ten
findings.what_is_owed: Count sector exposure after the doors are merged, not on the seat tally alone.

findings.claim: Convergence is less independent than the count suggests: two seat pairs repeat. raschke and weis are together on both FIVN and SAIL; livermore and oneil on both CART and BBY. That is 4 of the 10 multi-seat names.
findings.evidence: tally FIVN seats raschke, weis; SAIL seats raschke, weis; CART seats livermore, oneil; BBY seats livermore, oneil; ROKU seats minervini, thorp, wyckoff
findings.what_is_owed: Weigh a repeat pair as closer to one view when reading nomination_count; n is small, so a caution, not a finding of dependence.

findings.claim: Top conviction is concentrated: three of the four conviction-4 entries are livermore (EOG, CNQ, CDW), and CNQ and CDW have no second seat. Nobody has yet run the ticker-hidden test on them.
findings.evidence: tally CNQ nomination_count 1 convictions 4 doors STRENGTH, SOLO; CDW nomination_count 1 convictions 4 doors STRENGTH, SOLO; EOG convictions 2, 4; ESTC convictions 3, 4
findings.what_is_owed: Livermore states the case for CNQ and CDW with the ticker hidden and names what would prove each wrong.

findings.claim: No crowding objection: ROKU is the only three-seat name, the seats are distinct, it sits outside the clustered sectors and its MA stack is clean. Only note: structure is middling and structure_shift is RANGE, so agreement is on trend context, not a structure break.
findings.evidence: tally ROKU nomination_count 3 seats minervini, thorp, wyckoff convictions 3, 2, 3; ma_50 155.29 ma_100 147.56 ma_200 126.57; structure 61.1; structure_shift RANGE; div_state BULLISH; lens_warnings 0

findings.claim: Evidence-or-excitement check: CART's participation is far outside the room (about 5x its own 20-day average) and both seats cite strength. The event filter is not mine; I ask only that the case survive with the ticker hidden.

findings.what_is_owed: Livermore and oneil say how much of the case rests on today's volume versus the existing trend (ma_50 48.16 ma_100 46.82 ma_200 42.9).

findings.claim: A pullback needs a trend to pull back within (C5). COST's MA stack is descending, 50 under 100 under 200, so the longer-timeframe context is not up. If this is a counter-trend bounce the seats should say so; if a pullback, name the context.
findings.evidence: ma_50 938.86 ma_100 944.73 ma_200 969.35; structure 82.1; sc_momentum 71.0; lens_warnings 2; tally COST seats raschke, thorp convictions 3, 2 lane PULLBACK
findings.what_is_owed: Raschke and thorp name the higher-timeframe context the entry sits inside, or say it is counter-trend.

findings.claim: Seven nominated names have ma_50 below ma_100, six in the PULLBACK lane (HIW is MOMENTUM); OUT also has ma_50 under ma_200. The intermediate trend is not clearly up on these, so the trend they pull back within is owed in words.
findings.what_is_owed: Each nominating seat names the longer-timeframe trend or cycle for these seven; no context, no setup.

findings.evidence: div_state BEARISH; div_bear_count 5; day_vol 0.69; structure_shift RANGE; sc_momentum 76.6; tally VRNS nomination_count 1 seats wyckoff convictions 3 doors NOMINATED
findings.what_is_owed: Wyckoff explains the 5-of-5 divergence against the conviction, in the seat's own terms.

findings.claim: Four of five oscillators confirm bearish divergence with below-normal volume, and GTLB reaches the room through one seat at conviction 3. Caution flag fired; reasoning owed.
